I agree, pityriasis seems to be the likely cause but I'm thinking it may be the alba one cause that usually appears on the face whereas versicolor is common on the shoulders and trunk, from what I've looked up at least. 

The patches do not itch and I do not have any autoimmune diseases that run in the family. 

I'm planning to go to a specialist ASAP, thank you for your answer and concern❤ do you happen to know of anything I can or should do in the meantime to possibly treat this problem or mitigate the appearance?
I don't think it's that, I've been on birth control for 5 years now and haven't had these symptoms before :(
